Rules.InvariantScript:
Concurrent(
    ClearCollect(
        colApplyAndApplyAllTracking,
        'Apply and Apply All Trackings'
    );
    ,
    ClearCollect(
        colLandLeaseSubaccounts,
        Sort(
            'Land Lease Subaccounts',
            Order,
            SortOrder.Ascending
        )
    ),
    ClearCollect(
        colOtherOpexSubaccounts,
        Sort(
            Filter(
                'Opex Subaccounts',
                Not(
                    Or(
                        Account.Order = 1,
                        Name = "Operation & Maintenance"
                    )
                )
            ),
            Order,
            SortOrder.Ascending
        )
    ),
    ClearCollect(
        colOAndMSubaccounts,
        Filter(
            'Opex Subaccounts',
            Or(
                Account.Order = 1,
                Name = "Operation & Maintenance"
            )
        )
    ),
    ClearCollect(
        col_cmpCountryPickerItems,
        Sort(
            AddColumns(
                Countries,
                'Flag Image',
                Switch(
                    Name,
                    "Germany",
                    'germany-flag-png-large',
                    "Croatia",
                    'croatia-flag-png-large',
                    "France",
                    'france-flag-png-large',
                    "Greece",
                    'greece-flag-png-large',
                    "Finland",
                    'finland-flag-png-large',
                    "Spain",
                    'spain-flag-png-large',
                    "Italy",
                    'italy-flag-png-large',
                    "Poland",
                    'poland-flag-png-large',
                    "Romania",
                    'romania-flag-png-large'
                ),
                Order,
                Switch(
                    Name,
                    "Germany",
                    1,
                    "Croatia",
                    6,
                    "France",
                    2,
                    "Greece",
                    8,
                    "Finland",
                    5,
                    "Spain",
                    7,
                    "Italy",
                    4,
                    "Poland",
                    3,
                    "Romania",
                    9
                ),
                Expanded,
                false
            ),
            ThisRecord.Order
        )
    ),
    ClearCollect(
        colAdminCostCategories,
        Table(
            {
                Category: "DEVEX/CAPEX",
                IsFolded: true,
                TypeOfCategory: 'Contract Types'.'DEVEX/CAPEX'
            },
            {
                Category: "Operation & Maintenance",
                IsFolded: true,
                TypeOfCategory: 'Contract Types'.'Opex O&M'
            },
            {
                Category: "Land Lease",
                IsFolded: true,
                TypeOfCategory: 'Contract Types'.Landlease
            },
            {
                Category: "Other OPEX Costs",
                IsFolded: true,
                TypeOfCategory: 'Contract Types'.'Opex Other'
            }
        )
    ),
    ClearCollect(
        colOpexandLandLeaseStandardAssumptions,
        Sort(
            'OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions',
            Description,
            SortOrder.Ascending
        )
    ),
    /*
    ClearCollect(
        colDevexCapexAssumptions,
        'Devex/Capex Standard Assumptions'
    ),*/
    ClearCollect(
        colCapexAccountCategories,
        SortByColumns(
            Filter(
                'CAPEX Account Lists',
                And(
                    Not(IsBlank('Parent Account')),
                    'Parent Account'.Number = "00001"
                ),
                Not(Name = "Overleveraging")
            ),
            "vsb_order",
            SortOrder.Ascending
        )
    );
    ClearCollect(
        colCapexAccounts,
        Sort(
            Filter(
                'CAPEX Account Lists',
                'Parent Account'.'CAPEX Account List' in Filter(
                    colCapexAccountCategories,
                    Not(IsBlank(ThisRecord.'CAPEX Account List'))
                ).'CAPEX Account List'
            ),
            Order,
            SortOrder.Ascending
        )
    );
    ClearCollect(
        colCapexSubaccounts,
        SortByColumns(
            Filter(
                AddColumns(
                    'CAPEX Account Lists' As Item,
                    AccountOrder,
                    LookUp(
                        colCapexAccounts,
                        'CAPEX Account List' = Item.'Parent Account'.'CAPEX Account List'
                    ).Order,
                    CategoryOrder,
                    LookUp(
                        colCapexAccounts,
                        'CAPEX Account List' = Item.'Parent Account'.'CAPEX Account List'
                    ).'Parent Account'.Order,
                    AggregatedName,
                    Item.'Parent Account'.Name & " / " & Item.Name & " " & Item.Number,
                    Category,
                    LookUp(
                        colCapexAccounts,
                        'CAPEX Account List' = Item.'Parent Account'.'CAPEX Account List',
                        'Parent Account'.'CAPEX Account List'
                    )
                ),
                'Parent Account'.'CAPEX Account List' in colCapexAccounts.'CAPEX Account List'
            ),
            "CategoryOrder",
            SortOrder.Ascending,
            "AccountOrder",
            SortOrder.Ascending,
            "vsb_order",
            SortOrder.Ascending
        )
    ),
    ClearCollect(
        colSpvDevCoSubaccountsMapping,
        'SPVDevCo Mapping Capex Devexes'
    )
);
Select(btn_Filter_Devex_Capex_Assumptions)

Concurrent(
    Clear(colOpexandLandLeaseStandardAssumptions),
    Clear(colAdminCostCategories),
 //  Clear(col_cmpCountryPickerItems),
    Clear(colOAndMSubaccounts),
    Clear(colOtherOpexSubaccounts),
    Clear(colLandLeaseSubaccounts),
    UpdateContext(
        {
            locContractOrPeriodToDelete: Blank(),
            locNextPeriodReferenceCost: Blank(),
           
            locParentPeriod: Blank(),
            
            locSelectedLandLeaseCost: Blank(),
            locSelectedLandLeaseSubaccount: Blank(),
            locSelectedOAndMSubaccount: Blank(),
            locSelectedOtherOpexSubaccount: Blank(),
            locSelectedCategory: Blank()
        }
    )
)

    (IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project) || IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project.Status)),
    Color.Transparent,
    If(
        Or(
            cmp_Header.Project.Status = "Abandoned",
            "Inactive" in cmp_Header.Project.Status
        ),
        gblAppColors.Error,
        gblAppColors.ApprovalClusterStates.InProgress

    Or(
        gblEnvironmentName = "QA",

        "Inactive" in cmp_Header.Project.Status,

        Icon.Information
    )
)

            cmp_Header.Project.Status = "Abandoned",

        ),
        cmp_Header.Project.Status,
        "Active"

    false,

Rules.InvariantScript:
Table(
    {
        ItemKey: "AddStandardContractType",
        ItemDisplayName: "Add Contract Type",
        ItemIconName: "More",
        ItemEnabled: true
    },
    Switch(
        ThisItem.Category,
        "Land Lease",
        ForAll(
            colLandLeaseSubaccounts As RecordItem,
            {
                ItemParentKey: "AddStandardContractType",
                ItemKey: "Add" & Substitute(
                    RecordItem.vsb_name,
                    " ",
                    ""
                ),
                ItemDisplayName: Text(RecordItem.vsb_name),
                ItemEnabled: CountIf(
                    colOpexandLandLeaseStandardAssumptions,
                    And(
                        'Land Lease Subaccount'.'Land Lease Subaccount' = RecordItem.'Land Lease Subaccount',
                        'Type Of Contract' = 'Contract Types'.Landlease,
                        Text(Technology) = cmp_Admin_Costs_Assumption_NestedCountryPickerColumn.SelectedNestedValue,
                        Country.Country = cmp_Admin_Costs_Assumption_NestedCountryPickerColumn.SelectedCountry.Country
                    )
                ) = 0,
                ItemGUID: RecordItem.'Land Lease Subaccount'
            }
        ),
        "Other OPEX Costs",
        ForAll(
            colOtherOpexSubaccounts As RecordItem,
            {
                ItemParentKey: "AddStandardContractType",
                ItemKey: "Add" & Substitute(
                    RecordItem.vsb_name,
                    " ",
                    ""
                ),
                ItemDisplayName: If(
                    Not(
                        IsBlank(
                            Find(
                                "TCMA",
                                RecordItem.vsb_name
                            )
                        )
                    ),
                    "TCMA",
                    Not(
                        IsBlank(
                            Find(
                                "Environmental",
                                RecordItem.vsb_name
                            )
                        )
                    ),"E&CM",
                    Text(RecordItem.vsb_name)
                ),
                ItemEnabled: CountIf(
                    colOpexandLandLeaseStandardAssumptions,
                    And(
                        'Opex Subaccount'.'Opex Subaccount' = RecordItem.'Opex Subaccount',
                        'Type Of Contract' = 'Contract Types'.'Opex Other',
                        Text(Technology) = cmp_Admin_Costs_Assumption_NestedCountryPickerColumn.SelectedNestedValue,
                        Country.Country = cmp_Admin_Costs_Assumption_NestedCountryPickerColumn.SelectedCountry.Country
                    )
                ) = 0,
                ItemGUID: RecordItem.'Opex Subaccount'
            }
        ),
        "Operation & Maintenance",
        ForAll(
            colOAndMSubaccounts As RecordItem,
            {
                ItemParentKey: "AddStandardContractType",
                ItemKey: "Add" & Substitute(
                    RecordItem.vsb_name,
                    " ",
                    ""
                ),
                ItemDisplayName: Text(RecordItem.vsb_name),
                ItemEnabled: CountIf(
                    colOpexandLandLeaseStandardAssumptions,
                    And(
                        'Opex Subaccount'.'Opex Subaccount' = RecordItem.'Opex Subaccount',
                        'Type Of Contract' = 'Contract Types'.'Opex O&M',
                        Text(Technology) = cmp_Admin_Costs_Assumption_NestedCountryPickerColumn.SelectedNestedValue,
                        Country.Country = cmp_Admin_Costs_Assumption_NestedCountryPickerColumn.SelectedCountry.Country
                    )
                ) = 0,
                ItemGUID: RecordItem.'Opex Subaccount'
            }
        )
    )
)

If(
        And(
            ThisItem.Period = 'Opex & Land Lease Period'.'Period 1',
            Not(ThisItem.'IsLastPeriod?')
        ),
        40,

            ThisItem.'IsLastPeriod?',
            Not(ThisItem.'IsCollapsed?')
        ),
        80,

            ThisItem.'IsLastPeriod?',
            ThisItem.'IsCollapsed?'
        ),
        40,
        And(
            ThisItem.Period <> 'Opex & Land Lease Period'.'Period 1',
            Not(ThisItem.'IsLastPeriod?'),
            Not(ThisItem.'IsCollapsed?')
        ),
        40,
        And(
            ThisItem.Period <> 'Opex & Land Lease Period'.'Period 1',
            ThisItem.'IsCollapsed?'
        ),
        0,
        And(
            ThisItem.Period <> 'Opex & Land Lease Period'.'Period 1',
            ThisItem.'IsLastPeriod?',
            Not(ThisItem.'IsCollapsed?')
        ),
        80
    )

    RGBA(

    ),
    RGBA(
        0,

    )
)

    $"{ThisItem.'Duration In Years'} years"
)

    Not(IsBlank(ThisItem.'Duration in Months')),
    $"{ThisItem.'Duration in Months'} months"
)

If(

    "No",

Align.Right,Align.Left)

        "Yes",

    )

Switch(
    locSelectedCategory,
    'Contract Types'.'DEVEX/CAPEX',
    $"Are you sure you want to delete the ""{locSelectedStandardCost.Description}"" cost?",
    If(
        locSelectedLandLeaseCost.Period = 'Opex & Land Lease Period'.'Period 1',
        $"Are you sure you want to delete the ""{locSelectedLandLeaseCost.Description}"" contract and all related periods?",
        $"Are you sure you want to delete the ""{locSelectedLandLeaseCost.Description}"" period?"
    )
)

If(
    IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeaseCost) && IsBlank(locNextPeriodReferenceCost),
    $"Add Contract Type : {Coalesce(
        locSelectedLandLeaseSubaccount.Name,
        locSelectedOAndMSubaccount.Name,
        locSelectedOtherOpexSubaccount.Name
    )}",
    Not(IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeaseCost)) && locSelectedLandLeaseCost.Period = 'Opex & Land Lease Period'.'Period 1',
    $"Edit Contract : {Coalesce(
        locSelectedLandLeaseCost.'Land Lease Subaccount'.Name,
        locSelectedLandLeaseCost.'Opex Subaccount'.Name
    )}",
    Not(IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeaseCost)) && locSelectedLandLeaseCost.Period <> 'Opex & Land Lease Period'.'Period 1',
    $"Edit Period : {Coalesce(
        locSelectedLandLeaseCost.'Land Lease Subaccount'.Name,
        locSelectedLandLeaseCost.'Opex Subaccount'.Name
    )}",
    $"Add Period : {Coalesce(
        locNextPeriodReferenceCost.'Land Lease Subaccount'.Name,
        locNextPeriodReferenceCost.'Opex Subaccount'.Name
    )}"
)

    locSelectedLandLeaseCost.'Use Inflation Profile' = 'Use Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.No,

    locSelectedLandLeaseCost.'Use Inflation Profile',
    locNextPeriodReferenceCost.'Use Inflation Profile',
    If(
        locSelectedCategory in [
            'Contract Types'.'Opex O&M',
            'Contract Types'.'Opex Other'

        'Use Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,

)

        locSelectedLandLeaseCost.Period = 'Opex & Land Lease Period'.'Period 1',
        And(
            IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeaseCost),
            IsBlank(locNextPeriodReferenceCost)
        )
    ),
    DisplayMode.Edit,
    DisplayMode.Disabled
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
/*
If(
    And(Not(IsBlank(locSelectedOpexCostParent)),IsBlank(locSelectedOpexCost)),
    locSelectedOpexCostParent.'Use Country Inflation Profile',
    Not(IsBlank(locSelectedOpexCost)),
    //LookUp('Opex Project Costs', 'Opex Project Cost' = locSelectedOpexCost.'Opex Project Cost').'Use Country Inflation Profile'
    locSelectedOpexCost.'Use Country Inflation Profile'
)*/
/*If(
    locSelectedLandLeaseCost.'Use Country Inflation Profile' = 'Use Country Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.No,
    false,
    locSelectedLandLeaseCost.'Use Country Inflation Profile' = 'Use Country Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
    true,
    false
)*/
Coalesce(
    locSelectedLandLeaseCost.'Use Country Inflation Profile',
    locNextPeriodReferenceCost.'Use Country Inflation Profile',
    If(
        locSelectedCategory in [
            'Contract Types'.'Opex O&M',
            'Contract Types'.'Opex Other'
        ],
        'Use Country Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.Yes,
        'Use Country Inflation Profile (OPEX & Land Lease Standard Assumptions)'.No
    )
)

If(
    Or(
        locSelectedLandLeaseCost.Period = 'Opex & Land Lease Period'.'Period 1',
        And(
            IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeaseCost),
            IsBlank(locNextPeriodReferenceCost)
        )
    ),
    DisplayMode.Edit,
    DisplayMode.Disabled
)

        )

    DisplayMode.Edit,

)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    Or(
        locSelectedLandLeaseCost.Period = 'Opex & Land Lease Period'.'Period 1',
        And(
            IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeaseCost),
            IsBlank(locNextPeriodReferenceCost)
        )
    ),
    DisplayMode.Edit,
    DisplayMode.Disabled
)

If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount_1.Value)),
        Not(fn_Numeric_CC.IsTwoDecimal(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount_1.Value))
    ),
    $"Value must be a number",
    Not(
        fn_Numeric_CC.InRange(
            txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount_1.Value,
            0,
            1000000000
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and {Text(
        1000000000,
        "#,##0.0#"
    )}."
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    Or(
        locSelectedLandLeaseCost.Period = 'Opex & Land Lease Period'.'Period 1',
        And(
            IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeaseCost),
            IsBlank(locNextPeriodReferenceCost)
        )
    ),
    DisplayMode.Edit,
    DisplayMode.Disabled
)

If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount2_1.Value)),
        Not(fn_Numeric_CC.IsTwoDecimal(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount2_1.Value))
    ),
    $"Value must be a number",
    Not(
        fn_Numeric_CC.InRange(
            txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount2_1.Value,
            0,
            1000000000
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and {Text(
        1000000000,
        "#,##0.0#"
    )}."
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
Text(
    Coalesce(
        locSelectedLandLeaseCost.'Amount One-Time Payment 3',
        locNextPeriodReferenceCost.'Amount One-Time Payment 3'
    ),
    "##0.00"
)

If(
    Or(
        locSelectedLandLeaseCost.Period = 'Opex & Land Lease Period'.'Period 1',
        And(
            IsBlank(locSelectedLandLeaseCost),
            IsBlank(locNextPeriodReferenceCost)
        )
    ),
    DisplayMode.Edit,
    DisplayMode.Disabled
)

If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount3_1.Value)),
        Not(fn_Numeric_CC.IsTwoDecimal(txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount3_1.Value))
    ),
    $"Value must be a number",
    Not(
        fn_Numeric_CC.InRange(
            txt_LandLease_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Amount3_1.Value,
            0,
            1000000000
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and {Text(
        1000000000,
        "#,##0.0#"
    )}."
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
ClearCollect(
    colDevexCapexassumptions1,
    Ungroup(
        ForAll(
            Filter(
                colCapexAccountCategories As CT,
                !IsBlank(
                    LookUp(
                        'Devex/Capex Standard Assumptions',
                        And(
                            Category.'CAPEX Account List' = CT.'CAPEX Account List',
                            Country.Country = Coalesce(
                                cmp_Admin_Costs_Assumption_NestedCountryPickerColumn.SelectedCountry.Country,
                                First(col_cmpCountryPickerItems).Country
                            ),
                            Lower(Text(Technology)) = Lower(
                                Coalesce(
                                    cmp_Admin_Costs_Assumption_NestedCountryPickerColumn.SelectedNestedValue,
                                    "Wind"
                                )
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
            ) As Cat,
            Table(
                {
                    Category: Cat,
                    IsParent: true,
                    IsFolded: If(
                        IsBlank(locSelectedDevexCapexCategory),
                        true,
                        Cat.'CAPEX Account List' = locSelectedDevexCapexCategory.'CAPEX Account List',
                        false,
                        true
                    )
                },
                SortByColumns(
                    AddColumns(
                        Filter(
                            'Devex/Capex Standard Assumptions',
                            And(
                                Category.'CAPEX Account List' = Cat.'CAPEX Account List',
                                Country.Country = Coalesce(
                                    cmp_Admin_Costs_Assumption_NestedCountryPickerColumn.SelectedCountry.Country,
                                    First(col_cmpCountryPickerItems).Country
                                ),
                                Lower(Text(Technology)) = Lower(
                                    Coalesce(
                                        cmp_Admin_Costs_Assumption_NestedCountryPickerColumn.SelectedNestedValue,
                                        "Wind"
                                    )
                                )
                            )
                        ),
                        CategoryOrder,
                        Category.Order,
                        AccountOrder,
                        Subaccount.'Parent Account'.Order,
                        SubaccountOrder,
                        Subaccount.Order,
                        IsFolded,
                        If(
                            IsBlank(locSelectedDevexCapexCategory),
                            true,
                            Category.'CAPEX Account List' = locSelectedDevexCapexCategory.'CAPEX Account List',
                            false,
                            true
                        ),
                        IsParent,
                        false
                    ),
                    "CategoryOrder",
                    SortOrder.Ascending,
                    "AccountOrder",
                    SortOrder.Ascending,
                    "SubaccountOrder",
                    SortOrder.Ascending
                )
            )
        ),
        Value
    )
)
